verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Wyoming SOS runs online filing flows (Annual Report Wizard, online LLC formation, WyoBiz portal). However, nothing in the evidence publishes operating-hours windows, per-day filing limits, or session timeouts before a filer starts. The portal probe confirms only that the site is reachable and says nothing about availability rules.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
